run_train_net: run the detectron2 training script with a config file to train object detection models on GPU
run_train_net_eval_only: run the training script in eval-only mode to test a model on a dataset without training
build_evaluator: build an evaluator for a given dataset type like COCO, LVIS, or Cityscapes using the config
test_with_TTA: test a trained model with test-time augmentation enabled for improved inference accuracy on R-CNN models
setup_cfg: setup and merge detectron2 config from a file and command-line arguments then freeze the config
